name: ui-elements
usage: <script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/zevaverbach/ui-elements@v0.1.0/components/<file>"></script> then use the tag. Optional theme: <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/zevaverbach/ui-elements@v0.1.0/tokens.css">. Each module registers itself; load only what you use. For runtime UI swaps, see docs/state-and-shell.md: keep stores and long-lived UI in a stable shell and swap only the outlet.

tokens.notes: Optional. Components fall back to built-in light/dark values. Set data-theme="light|dark" on <html> to force a scheme.

components.description: A single to-do item with checkbox, inline edit, confirm-to-delete, optional progress steps, a Web Speech microphone button (hidden where unsupported) and drag/keyboard/touch reordering among sibling items.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: Item text. Reflects to the text property.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Item is done.

attributes.name: editing
attributes.description: Inline edit mode.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Small eyebrow label above the text.

attributes.name: progress
attributes.description: If present, shows four progress steps (25/50/75/100). Checking sets 100; unchecking from 100 sets 75.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.description: BCP-47 language for dictation. Default: document language.

attributes.name: no-speech
attributes.description: Never show the microphone button.

attributes.name: no-reorder
attributes.description: Hide the drag handle and disable reordering.

attributes.name: no-confirm
attributes.description: Delete on the first click instead of arm-then-confirm.

slots.name: meta
slots.description: Extra content under the text (tags, due date).

events.name: ui-delete
events.description: Delete confirmed. Cancelable; if not prevented the element removes itself.

events.name: ui-transcript
events.description: Speech-to-text result; value is the edit field after a final result is appended.

events.name: ui-reorder
events.description: Item moved among sibling ui-todo-items; the DOM is already updated.

components.notes: Place several ui-todo-items under one parent (div/ul) to get a reorderable list; reordering applies to siblings with the same tag. Keyboard: Space/Enter on the handle grabs, Arrow keys move, Space/Enter drops, Escape cancels.

components.description: A backend-agnostic chat panel that slides on and off the screen edge, with a message log, composer and a ui-send event for user messages.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Panel is on screen.

attributes.name: side
attributes.description: Edge it slides from. Default right.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Header title.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Composer placeholder. Default "Message…".

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: Shows a pending bubble and disables Send.

attributes.name: busy-text
attributes.description: Pending bubble text. Default "Thinking…".

attributes.name: backdrop
attributes.description: Show a scrim; clicking it closes the panel.

attributes.name: no-echo
attributes.description: Do not append the user's message to the log on send.

attributes.name: store
attributes.description: Optional ui-store name. Messages render from the store and a sent message becomes an `add` ui-action {role:'user', text}. Without it, behavior is unchanged.

attributes.name: store-path
attributes.description: Dot path of the messages array in the store. Default "messages".

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Messages as light-DOM elements with data-role="user|agent|error".

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Extra header buttons before the close button.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Content between the log and the composer.

events.name: ui-send
events.description: User submitted a message. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the draft.

events.name: ui-action
events.detail: {store: string, action: "add", payload: {path: string, item: {role: "user", text: string}}}
events.description: Only when `store` is set: the user's message as a store action (routed by the store registry).

components.notes: Toggle from any button with panel.toggle(). Slide animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Never makes network calls: the host listens for ui-send and calls addMessage('agent', ...).

components.description: Non-visual element declaring named, observable, optionally persistent JSON state; data lives in a registry outside the element so it survives the element being removed or swapped.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Store name. Without it the element warns and does nothing.

attributes.name: persist
attributes.description: Where to persist. Default none. Storage key is "ui-store:<name>" unless `key` is set.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Override the storage key.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Schema version, default "1". Stored value is {v, data}; a different stored v is ignored and the seed is used.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Fetch JSON as the seed on first creation. Failure is non-fatal. Seed precedence: persisted, src, inline script.

slots.name: (none)
slots.description: A child <script type="application/json"> holds the inline seed.

events.name: ui-store-change
events.description: After every change (path is "" if several paths changed in one batch). Hook for server sync.

actions.how: Dispatch a bubbling, composed `ui-action` event with detail {store, action, payload} from anywhere; it is routed by store name, not DOM position. Or call act()/dispatch() directly.
actions.scope: Operate on the array of objects at payload.path (default "items"); items are identified by id.

list.name: add
list.description: Assigns id via crypto.randomUUID() if missing.

components.notes: Declare stores in the stable shell, outside the swapped outlet. Safe inside the outlet too: data is not deleted when the element is removed. Seed is used only when no store of that name exists. Values must be JSON-serializable.

components.description: Renders one child component per item of a store array, reconciling by key so focus and transient state survive, and turns child events into store actions.

attributes.name: store
attributes.description: Store name (may be declared later).

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Dot path of the array in the store. Default "items".

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: Child tag, e.g. ui-todo-item.

attributes.name: map
attributes.description: Item field (dot path ok) to child attribute. true sets a boolean attribute; false/null/undefined removes it. Example {"text":"text","checked":"done"}.

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Item field used for identity. Default "id".

attributes.name: events
attributes.description: Child event to action. "$detail.x" strings read event.detail.x. Example {"ui-toggle":{"action":"toggle","field":"done"},"ui-reorder":{"action":"move"},"ui-delete":{"action":"remove"},"ui-edit":{"action":"update","patch":{"text":"$detail.text"}}}. Cancelled (preventDefault) cancelable events dispatch nothing.

attributes.name: where
attributes.description: Optional equality filter, e.g. {"done":false}. Reorders inside a filtered view map to the full array.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Give it a stable id: children get ids "<id>-<key>" and the morph keeps them.

slots.name: (none)
slots.description: Renders children into its own light DOM with display: contents.

events.name: ui-action
events.description: Dispatched for each mapped child event; routed to the store by name.

components.notes: The child tag is supplied by `tag`, so any component whose attributes and events fit map/events works. ui-each must have a ui-store with the same name somewhere in the page (stores are routed by name).

compositions.name: To-do list beside a chat
compositions.description: A reorderable list is several ui-todo-item siblings in one container; a ui-chat-panel sits at the page level and is toggled by any button. Wire ui-transcript or ui-send to your own logic.

compositions.name: Stable shell with a swappable outlet
compositions.description: Stores and long-lived UI stay in the shell; only <main id="outlet"> is ever replaced, via swapOutlet() from components/_shared/outlet.js. Agent HTML contains only ui-* and plain layout tags, never script. See docs/state-and-shell.md and demo/shell.html.
compositions.html: <ui-store name="todos" persist="local"></ui-store><ui-chat-panel store="chat" id="chat"></ui-chat-panel><main id="outlet"><ui-each id="todos" store="todos" tag="ui-todo-item" map='{"text":"text","checked":"done"}' events='{"ui-toggle":{"action":"toggle","field":"done"}}'></ui-each></main>
